verdict.rationale: Clerky supports structured document customization, real-time collaboration, attorney review/commenting, and audit logging of changes (clerky-docs-3, clerky-docs-4, clerky-docs-12, clerky-docs-13), which replaces some email-attachment workflows for startup formation paperwork. However, it is built around fixed legal templates (safes, stock plans, IRS forms) rather than general contract drafting/negotiation, and there is no evidence of redline/track-changes tooling, version comparison, or counterparty negotiation workflows typical of a CLM tool. Missing for 10: redline/track-changes support, multi-party negotiation workflow, version comparison, evidence beyond startup-formation document types.
